items.prompt: The supplied parser passes price token "10.10" unchanged. Which conversion matches the source?

options.why: The token contains a decimal point and is not an integer literal.
A binary-float round trip is unnecessary and can lose exactness for other valid decimal prices.
The exact two-digit fractional grammar permits an all-integer conversion.
That confuses integer cents with the original dollar scale.

items.explanation: The exact two-digit fractional grammar permits an all-integer conversion.
